name: Walmart Marketplace
description: America’s leading retail giant marketplace reaching 120M+ monthly shoppers with official Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS).
fullDescription: Walmart Marketplace grants vetted third-party sellers direct access to over 120 million monthly digital shoppers across the United States. Sellers benefit from low seller-to-shopper competition compared to Amazon, 2-day nationwide fulfillment through Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS), and seamless omnichannel brand presence.
features: Access to 120M+ active unique monthly digital visitors across the US
Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) with guaranteed 2-day delivery badges
No monthly recurring account subscription fee (pay-per-sale referral only)
Rich product listing features including Pro Seller badge recognition
Walmart Connect sponsored product and sponsored video advertising suite
